questions.stem: What deficiency disease is caused by a lack of vitamin C?
questions.explanation: Scurvy is caused by a lack of vitamin C, which is needed for collagen production. Symptoms include bleeding gums, weakness, and poor wound healing.

questions.stem: What mineral deficiency can lead to anaemia?
questions.explanation: Iron deficiency can cause anaemia because iron is needed to make haemoglobin in red blood cells. Without enough iron, the blood cannot carry sufficient oxygen.

questions.stem: What disease results from a lack of vitamin D and calcium?
questions.explanation: Rickets is caused by a deficiency of vitamin D and/or calcium, leading to soft and weak bones that can become bowed. Vitamin D is needed for calcium absorption.

options.text: A disease caused by vitamin C deficiency
A disease caused by lack of water
A form of severe protein deficiency, common in developing countries
A disease caused by too much fat in the diet

questions.explanation: Kwashiorkor is a form of severe malnutrition caused by protein deficiency. It is characterised by a swollen belly, muscle wasting, and weakened immune system.

questions.stem: Which vitamin is needed for healthy bones and teeth?
questions.explanation: Vitamin D is essential for healthy bones and teeth because it helps the body absorb calcium from food. It can be obtained from sunlight, oily fish, and fortified foods.

options.text: A long-term energy imbalance where energy intake exceeds energy expenditure

questions.explanation: Obesity results from a long-term energy imbalance where more energy is consumed in food than is used by the body. The excess energy is stored as fat.

questions.stem: Why is a varied diet important for preventing deficiency diseases?

options.text: Different foods provide different nutrients, so variety ensures all essential nutrients are obtained
Eating the same food every day prevents disease
All nutrients come from just one food type
A varied diet is lower in calories

questions.explanation: No single food contains all the nutrients the body needs. Eating a variety of foods ensures that all essential vitamins, minerals, and other nutrients are obtained in adequate amounts.
